summary: Release an outermost cold replication snapshot reader before CPU construction

replay.detail: Projection replay, canonical ordering, and complete digest coverage are unchanged.

schema.detail: No table, index, trigger, or schema-version change. A stale seeded batch cursor is conditionally clamped in existing meta on startup before new batch rowids can be reused.

rules.detail: Envelope authority, receipt admission, pending guards, signing, and checkpoint rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire, archive, API, or peer protocol change. Legacy graph digest and complete inventory inputs remain on one database cut.

downtime.detail: The snapshot cache rebuilds from committed inputs after an outermost read transaction ends; nested caller-owned reads keep their original cut.

manual.detail: No operator action or migration command is needed.

recovery.detail: Reopening after checkpoint trim persists the existing batch cursor clamp so reused rowids cannot hide pending local work. Rollback and older-reader/newer-cache protections remain.
